followup_probes.conclusion: On SM86 + triton 3.0, in-register E4M3-decode GEMM is 2.2-2.8x slower than cuBLAS on pre-decoded BF16. The fused-register-decode race branch is CLOSED for this stack.
followup_probes.next_race_candidate: INT8 IMMA core GEMMs via MXINT techniques: every E4M3 value = 4-bit int (1..15) x pow2; E8M0 block scales fold exactly. Repo-proven 1.76x P0 gain on experts (mxint.py). Requires activation int8 quantization exactness proof for core (q_W=2W-style). Distinct phase, not a patch.
followup_probes.gate_status: K56 workspace-decode async 183.9 ms STEADY = WEAK (gate <=130 not met). Fused 215.0 ms (MISS). Core INT8 IMMA is the remaining §10 race option.

track_a_v5.gate_analysis: Full core ~173 ms (vs workspace-decode 183.9). Gate <=130 requires GEMM <=1.9 ms/layer (1.43x cuBLAS); wall after v1-v5 = ~2.2x cuBLAS on SM86/triton3. Remaining Track A headroom: (a) non-GEMM 1.04 ms/layer — attention einsum 0.94 ms eager -> SDPA + fused norms/router/hc via torch.compile could recover ~0.5-0.6 ms/layer; (b) marginal GEMM tuning. Combined optimistic floor ~155-165 ms.
track_a_v5.strategic_note: Track A remaining gap (~50 ms to gate) has 10x less Exact-30 leverage than Track B owner work: MoE gu kernel has 12.5x bytes-floor headroom on a 1605 ms block vs core at 173 ms total. Track B first; Track A (a) is the next core move.

results.cluster_compile: norms/router/hc cluster eager 0.118 -> compiled 0.043 ms (2.74x), BITWISE identical (maxdiff 0). Safe, free.
results.wo_a_bmm: bmm == einsum time (1.02x), bitwise. No gain.
results.attn_sdpa: 1.33x faster (0.965 -> 0.725 ms) BUT maxdiff 5.62 vs einsum — NOT parity-safe. Also the softmax einsum is itself a timing approximation of DSA top-k attention; real parity requires the DSA kernel. Flag: adopt SDPA-shaped timing only after exact-attention work.
